name: consolidate
description:
Dream consolidation — discovers hidden connections between memories. Groups entities by shared context, creates CO_OCCURS graph edges, identifies clusters.

CALL WHEN:
- At the end of a productive work session
- When the user says 'wrap up' or 'that's it for now'
- When you want to force background consolidation for the current session

Smart ingest automatically queues consolidation after enough new entities; you do not need to count memories manually.
Cost: request path only queues work; the background worker does the consolidation.
